scientific_integrity: Exact derivation plus independently coded integer cyclotomic checks of finite orders; finite checks are not substituted for proof of the infinite classification.
scientific_limitations: Fixed four-row pattern and complex exact arithmetic only; uses the published classification of minimal vanishing sums of roots of unity; the continuous ambiguity families and determinant factorization were known; the new scope is an explicit all-modulus rank-defect census, not independent review.
title: An exact all-modulus rank-defect census for the four-row Fourier pattern \(\{0,1,3,4\}\)
